entry.title: Powder Tower, Riga
entry.note: The exact-identity cylindrical outline supplies the center. The tower keeps its complete circular exterior, with shared walls naturally hidden by surrounding map buildings. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
